digest.component_or_area: Makefile typecheck target and mypy configuration
propositions: The Makefile typecheck recipe only runs mypy over src/rebar, excluding the 47 .py files under scripts/ that are linted but not type-checked
CI's type-check gate runs make typecheck and directly invokes scripts/*.py files (e.g. check_verify_gate_parity.py), so the programs enforcing the Verified vote are outside the type gate

Widening the mypy scope to include scripts/ surfaced 15 type errors across 6 files, all fixable at source with no per-module overrides, and two were latent bugs (strip() on str | None, and a None-check guard in the wrong branch)
The sys.path bootstraps in scripts/ are already accommodated by pyproject.toml's follow_imports=silent and ignore_missing_imports=true, so they are not a structural blocker
Stale type-gate scope descriptions in .pre-commit-config.yaml and .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml must be updated to reflect the widened scope
